objective: Analyze our existing software development processes and draft improved process documentation aligned with the supplied Automotive SPICE 4.1 source material. Preserve valid existing practices and distinguish gaps from missing evidence.
scope: SWE.1 to SWE.6 software engineering processes.
Include roles, process interfaces, work products and traceability.
Do not claim an official capability rating or assessment outcome.
quality_criteria: Cite source document and location for every substantive finding.
Keep normative indicators distinct from actual mandatory requirements.
Do not equate documented process design with demonstrated implementation.
Do not invent requirements or project evidence.
constraints: Use only a local LLM unless an external payload is separately authorized.
Never overwrite input or reference documents.
Human approval is required before final publication.

tasks.title: Inventory documents
tasks.purpose: Identify sources, document roles, and versions.

tasks.title: Extract document content
tasks.purpose: Parse and normalize source content and source locations.

tasks.title: Build local retrieval index
tasks.purpose: Enable exact and semantic retrieval over local sources.

tasks.title: Analyze documents
tasks.purpose: Identify concepts, structures, responsibilities, and findings.

tasks.title: Identify gaps
tasks.purpose: Separate missing information, conflicting evidence, and confirmed gaps.

tasks.title: Design document structure
tasks.purpose: Define the proposed outline and document interfaces.

tasks.title: Generate document drafts
tasks.purpose: Produce output drafts from approved sources and structure.

tasks.title: Validate outputs
tasks.purpose: Verify source support and stated quality criteria.

tasks.title: Review and approve outputs
tasks.purpose: Require a human decision before publication.

tasks.title: Publish local artifacts
tasks.purpose: Write approved outputs under the local project folder.

assumptions: Rule-based planning is heuristic; review its capability selection.
warnings: Stage 1 creates and reviews a plan only; document processing is not implemented yet.
External LLM calls are not implemented. Ollama mode uses local loopback only.
